captions.detailed: This 3D model is a compact, rectangular desk box fan constructed primarily from light gray plastic. The front face features a square protective grid with square openings, through which a dark gray five-blade rotor is visible. On the right side of the main housing, there is a protruding cylindrical assembly holding a three-position speed control knob. The rotor is mounted on a continuous revolute joint, allowing it to spin freely, while the speed knob is mounted on a separate revolute joint with defined angular limits.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact desk box fan in light gray plastic. The model must feature a rectangular outer casing, a front protective grid, a dark gray five-blade rotor on a continuous revolute joint, and a three-position speed dial on the right side mounted on a revolute joint with appropriate rotation limits.
captions.factory: The base/housing of the fan is constructed by combining a main Box and a front grille. The grille is patterned using intersecting thin box extrusions to form a grid. The rotor is constructed by combining a central Cylinder hub with five individual blade shapes created from extruded polygons or rotated box shapes, spaced evenly at 72-degree intervals. The side control knob assembly is built using concentric cylinders of varying diameters and lengths, with a small rectangular key added for the pointer. Two articulations are defined: a continuous revolute joint for the rotor spinning about its axis, and a limited revolute joint for the control knob's rotation.
